decisions.reason: As a cloud contact centre service that builds directly on our existing managed communications, cloud and support capabilities, it fits our knowledge base well and gives us strong scope to learn from early adoption and improve it through our in-house development and partner ecosystem.

As a call number routing platform close to our core voice and connectivity services, it draws on infrastructure and operational know-how we already possess, so absorptive capacity is high and the product is worth retaining and refining rather than exiting early.
